title: Fine-scale ancestry can matter after PC adjustment

crops.alt: Figure 12. Hu et al. Figure 3c, birthplace north/south, original axes
Original Hu et al. trait-category legend

notes: Original Figure 3c of Hu et al. (2025), enlarged from the publisher asset. Each point is a reported GWAS signal, colored according to the original legend. Vertical axis -log10(P_PC); horizontal axis -log10(P_AC). Large vertical values with smaller horizontal values illustrate birthplace associations attenuated with ancestry components. The panel does not by itself show that every removed association is a false causal signal. The full original figure, legend and methods remain linked.

title: All of Us: a continuous cloud with dense regions

crops.alt: Figure 29. All of Us published Figure 1c, PC1/PC2 and PC1/PC3 groups

notes: Original Figure 1c of Sharma et al. (2025), full-resolution crop, shows 7 density-defined PCA groups. The study separately identified 13 UMAP groups, illustrating dependence on representation and resolution. N=297,549 in the analyzed controlled-tier array-data sample (v7); this is not the whole All of Us program. Participants self-identifying as American Indian/Alaska Native were excluded from the analyzed release. Published group colors do not define discrete biological types. The original numerical comparison is retained in the appendix.
